purpose: The memory layer: where every record is stored. The other layers each define the records they write here and the conventions for them; this layer defines only how a record is stored and found (route, schema, provenance), the decision log, the venture profile, design documents and the sources behind them. Storage is not fixed: files today, a database later (EE-036).
gaps: No check on the venture profile or design documents of its own; design-coverage (evidence) is the only one
Records are stored as files only; the router has no storage interface for a database yet
